claims: Maintain targeted temperature management at 35°C using the Arctic Sun device, with ongoing shivering assessment.
Continue mechanical ventilation in APV (CMV) mode with set tidal volume 450 mL, PEEP 5 cmH2O, FiO2 50%, and respiratory rate 15/min.
Continue propofol and fentanyl infusions to maintain deep sedation (goal RASS -5) during targeted temperature management.
Continue norepinephrine infusion and monitor hemodynamics with non-invasive blood pressure and heart rate alarms.
Continue empiric broad-spectrum antibiotics (cefepime, vancomycin, metronidazole, ceftazidime) and monitor for infection given leukocytosis and sputum specimen.
Monitor coagulation parameters (PTT, INR, platelet count) and continue heparin infusion with titration.
Monitor blood glucose and administer insulin or dextrose per protocol to maintain euglycemia.
Monitor and replace electrolytes (potassium, magnesium, calcium, phosphate) as indicated by laboratory results.
Perform regular oral care, subglottal suctioning, and maintain endotracheal cuff pressure to prevent ventilator-associated pneumonia.
Reposition patient and implement pressure ulcer prevention strategies given Braden score indicating high risk.
